---
name: clubcoachfeature-task
description: implement club coach funtionality
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->
-  be able to perform the following tasks:
  -  after login they should be directed to their dashboard.
  -  see their scheduled sessions and upcoming events.
  -  be able to manage their sessions, including creating, updating, and canceling them.
  -  receive notifications for any changes to their schedule.
  -  have access to participant information for their sessions and events.
  -  be able to communicate with participants through the platform.
  -  have access to performance analytics and feedback for their sessions and events.
  -  be able to set goals and track progress for their participants.
  -  have the ability to generate reports on session attendance and participant performance.
  -  be able to execute their coaching plans and strategies effectively and take notes on participant progress and areas for improvement.
  -  be able to provide personalized feedback and recommendations to participants based on their performance and progress.
  -  be able to collaborate with other coaches and staff members to enhance the overall coaching experience.
  -  be able to stay updated with the latest coaching techniques and best practices through the platform.
  -  be able to provide mentorship and guidance to junior coaches and new staff members.
  -  be able to submit participants' video recordings for AI analysis and feedback.
  -  be able to review AI-generated feedback and incorporate it into their coaching strategies.
  -  be able to provide feedback on the AI analysis to improve its accuracy and relevance.
  -  be able to integrate AI-generated insights into their coaching plans and strategies.
  -  be able to track the effectiveness of AI-generated recommendations and adjust their coaching methods accordingly.
  -  be able to provide input on the development of new AI features and improvements within the platform.
  -  be able to assess participants' skills, performance, and development needs accurately and will be able to promote their growth and development effectively and move to the next level in their training journey.
